sloka: अयोमुखैस्त्रिर्भिर्विद्ध्वा राक्षसेन्द्रं विभीषणम्।एकैकेनाभिविव्याध तान् सर्वान् हरियूथपान् ।। ६.९१.४० ।।
transliteration: ayomukhaistrirbhirviddhvā rākṣasendraṁ vibhīṣaṇam।ekaikenābhivivyādha tān sarvān hariyūthapān ।। 6.91.40 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana's son in his charming countenance, filled with wrath because of conflict, struck at Vibheeshana with three arrows.
